label: Check the traits before any rule
Rules 1 and 2: invalid traits, per-user data
code:
if (!isValid(page)) return { route, strategy: "invalid", reason: "invalid traits" };
if (page.perUserData) return { route, strategy: "dynamic", reason: "per-user data" };

label: Rule 3: pages that read request-time APIs
code:
const reads = REQUEST_APIS.filter((api) => page.reads.includes(api));
if (reads.length > 0) return { route, strategy: "dynamic", reason: `reads ${reads.join(", ")}` };

label: Rule 4: HTML that must be fresh every time
code: if (page.freshnessSeconds === 0) return { route, strategy: "dynamic", reason: "must be fresh on every request" };

label: Rule 5: where the HTML comes from
code: const where = page.dataAtBuild && page.pageCount <= MAX_BUILD_PAGES ? "prerendered at build" : "rendered on first request";
